claims.definition: Recorded historic win rate for TenderLab-supported submissions in the concluded management reporting cohort.
claims.limitations: The reporting period and denominator are held in TenderLab management records and are not inferred from the separate 200+ submissions-supported figure. It is not a forecast or guarantee.

claims.definition: More than 200 tender submissions completed or reviewed with TenderLab support.
claims.limitations: This is a volume measure and is not the denominator used for the 92% historic win-rate measure.

claims.definition: More than £50 million in aggregate contract value linked to successful TenderLab-supported submissions.
claims.limitations: Aggregate contract value is not TenderLab revenue, guaranteed provider revenue or proof that every available lot or call-off was used.

claims.definition: TenderLab-supported answers that received a documented maximum score where the authority used a five-point evaluation scale.
claims.limitations: This is a question-level result, not a universal score across every response or procurement.
